data.title: 卡芙卡 · 奢华套房的蛛网支配
data.description: 成年卡芙卡独自跨坐紫色绒榻，一手抓靠背、一手在腿间指交，幽紫蛛丝只环绕她自己的腰臀。

data.promptProse: Adult Kafka straddles the velvet chaise, gripping its backrest with one hand and touching herself with the other. Spectral threads curve around her hips. Dim purple room light mixes with the faint bedside candlelight.
data.animaCaption: Rich golden ambient light from crystal chandeliers glints off her wine glass as Kafka reclines in utter command.
